Background: PR #792 rewrote sql/v3/migrations/010_v3_system_search_body_type_counts.sql so it adds 18 count columns NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 and 18 CHECK constraints declared NOT VALID (the 18 names, verified from the file on PR #792's branch: system_search_ammonia_count_check, system_search_bio_signal_total_check, system_search_black_hole_count_check, system_search_elw_count_check, system_search_gas_giant_count_check, system_search_geo_signal_total_check, system_search_hmc_count_check, system_search_icy_count_check, system_search_metal_rich_count_check, system_search_neutron_count_check, system_search_other_star_count_check, system_search_ring_count_check, system_search_rocky_count_check, system_search_rocky_ice_count_check, system_search_terraformable_count_check, system_search_walkable_count_check, system_search_white_dwarf_count_check, system_search_ww_count_check; confirm them yourself with `git show origin/codex/run-37990099189-1:sql/v3/migrations/010_v3_system_search_body_type_counts.sql | grep -o 'system_search_[a-z_]*_check' | sort -u` and stop if the set differs; its sha256 is a042ccd1544d95cf47407a0722497321a544f15c62ac07dc83c914a19d7acbdf and that is the ledger hash the action must require). NOT VALID means existing rows were not checked; `ALTER TABLE ... VALIDATE CONSTRAINT` scans the table (about 198.5 million rows today) under a SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE lock that does not block reads or inserts. Each VALIDATE can take minutes, so it cannot run inside the 120-second migration runner; it needs a detached runner with a separate status action. Read CLAUDE.md, the ROADMAP section, docs/operations/v3-finder-production-rollout-state.md rows 1-3, scripts/operator/actions/v3-system-search-f1.sh (detached pattern, require_target, db_query, ledger check), scripts/operator/actions/v3-derived-lifecycle-status.sh (receipt style), tests/test_v3_derived_lifecycle_status.py and tests/test_v3_system_search_production_operator.py BEFORE writing.

PART 1 - the action script, bash, `set -euo pipefail`, first argument `start` or `status` (anything else: emit a stopped receipt and exit 64). Constants: TARGET_HOSTNAME=ed-finder-prod, TARGET_FQDN=nb79a3d.mevnode.com, POSTGRES_CONTAINER=edfinder-v3-phase4c-full-20260827_r5-postgres, DATABASE_USER=edfinder_v3, DATABASE_NAME=edfinder_v3_phase4c_full_20260827_r5 (same as v3-system-search-f1.sh), MIGRATION_NAME=010_v3_system_search_body_type_counts.sql, MIGRATION_SHA=a042ccd1544d95cf47407a0722497321a544f15c62ac07dc83c914a19d7acbdf, TABLE=v3_derived.system_search, the 18 CONSTRAINT names as a bash array in a fixed order, LOCK_TIMEOUT=5s, STATEMENT_TIMEOUT=45min, RUN_DIR=/tmp/edfinder-validate-constraints (a directory INSIDE the postgres container; it holds run.sql, run.log and run.pid). require_target(): same checks as v3-system-search-f1.sh (docker present, hostname, fqdn, docker context default on the local rootful socket, postgres container present and running). db_query(): `docker exec $POSTGRES_CONTAINER psql -X --no-psqlrc --no-password --tuples-only --no-align --quiet --set ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --username $DATABASE_USER --dbname $DATABASE_NAME --command "$1"` and every read wraps its SQL in BEGIN READ ONLY; ...; COMMIT;.
Shared read: constraint_state() returns one line per constraint from `SELECT c.conname, c.convalidated FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class r ON r.oid=c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=r.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='v3_derived' AND r.relname='system_search' AND c.contype='c' AND c.conname IN (<the 18 names, single-quoted>) ORDER BY c.conname` (the 18 names are hard-coded constants, not user input). active_validation() returns rows from `SELECT pid, state, now()-query_start, left(query,120) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND query ILIKE '%VALIDATE CONSTRAINT%' AND query ILIKE '%system_search%' AND pid<>pg_backend_pid()`.
`start` must, in order: require_target; check the ledger `SELECT encode(migration_sha256,'hex') FROM v3_meta.schema_migration WHERE migration_name='010_...'` equals MIGRATION_SHA else stop with failure migration_010_not_applied_or_hash_mismatch; read constraint_state and stop with failure constraint_set_incomplete if fewer than 18 rows come back; compute the list of constraints with convalidated=false; if empty, print a success receipt with result=nothing_to_validate and exit 0; stop with failure validation_already_running if active_validation() returns any row OR `docker exec $POSTGRES_CONTAINER sh -c 'test -f /tmp/edfinder-validate-constraints/run.pid && kill -0 $(cat /tmp/edfinder-validate-constraints/run.pid) 2>/dev/null'` succeeds; otherwise generate the SQL text: `\set ON_ERROR_STOP on`, `\timing on`, `SET lock_timeout = '5s';`, `SET statement_timeout = '45min';`, then for each unvalidated constraint in fixed order: `\echo validating <name>` and `ALTER TABLE v3_derived.system_search VALIDATE CONSTRAINT <name>;` (autocommit: each ALTER is its own transaction, so a failure leaves earlier ones validated and the catalog is the truth), ending with `\echo validate_constraints_complete`. Write that text into the container with `docker exec -i $POSTGRES_CONTAINER sh -c 'umask 077; mkdir -p /tmp/edfinder-validate-constraints && cat > /tmp/edfinder-validate-constraints/run.sql'` (stdin), then launch DETACHED: `docker exec -d $POSTGRES_CONTAINER sh -c 'cd /tmp/edfinder-validate-constraints && (psql -X --no-psqlrc --no-password --username edfinder_v3 --dbname edfinder_v3_phase4c_full_20260827_r5 -f run.sql > run.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> run.log) & echo $! > run.pid'`. Sleep 3 seconds, then prove it started: active_validation() returns at least one row OR run.log already contains validate_constraints_complete; else print the log tail to stderr and stop with failure validation_runner_did_not_start. Print the success receipt. The receipt is ONE line of JSON: {"schema_version":"ed-finder/operator-operation-result/v1","operation":"v3-system-search-validate-constraints-start","status":"success"|"stopped","result":"launched"|"nothing_to_validate"|null,"migration_010_sha256":...,"migration_010_verified":true/false,"constraints_total":18,"constraints_validated_before":N,"constraints_queued":[names],"lock_timeout":"5s","statement_timeout":"45min","read_only":false,"db_writes_performed":false (VALIDATE CONSTRAINT changes only the catalog flag; set "catalog_validation_launched":true instead),"data_rows_modified":false,"publication_performed":false,"canonical_writes_performed":false,"service_changes_performed":false,"failures":[...]}. Build the JSON with a small python3 -c or printf with %s on pre-validated values; never interpolate unvalidated text into JSON.
`status` must: require_target; print ONE JSON line {"operation":"v3-system-search-validate-constraints-status","status":"success","read_only":true,"db_writes_performed":false,"migration_010_in_ledger":bool,"constraints":[{"name":..,"validated":bool}...] (all 18),"validated_count":N,"all_validated":bool,"active_validations":[{pid,state,running_for,query}],"runner_pid_alive":bool,"log_tail":[last 40 lines of run.log or []],"failures":[]}. Reading run.log is `docker exec $POSTGRES_CONTAINER sh -c 'test -f /tmp/edfinder-validate-constraints/run.log && tail -n 40 /tmp/edfinder-validate-constraints/run.log'` (missing file is not a failure). status performs no writes at all.
Forbidden anywhere in the script (case-sensitive, these are checked by the tests): 'DROP ', 'DELETE ', 'TRUNCATE', 'INSERT ', 'UPDATE ', 'CREATE ', 'NOT VALID', 'docker restart', 'docker compose', 'docker stop', 'docker rm', 'systemctl', 'pg_dump', 'pg_restore', '.env', 'Config.Env', 'ADMIN_TOKEN', 'FRONTIER_CLIENT_SECRET', 'DATABASE_URL', '/root/.ssh'. The ONLY DDL in the file is `ALTER TABLE v3_derived.system_search VALIDATE CONSTRAINT`. Add a plain-language header comment: what it does, that VALIDATE only flips the catalog flag and does not modify rows, why it is detached, that re-running `start` resumes safely, and that the catalog (`pg_constraint.convalidated`) is the truth, not the log.
